avatar_brief: Woman 35-45, at a laptop at a desk, cardigan, half a coffee. Screen glow on her face. Delivery is dry and investigative — the register of someone who enjoys catching brands out and is mildly annoyed to have failed.
hook: I tried to find out where this brand actually makes things. I expected a warehouse in Shenzhen.
first_frame: Over-shoulder on a laptop showing a map zoomed to northern Norway, her hand on the trackpad.

beats.vo: I tried to find out where this brand actually makes things. I expected a warehouse in Shenzhen.
beats.visual: Over-shoulder, laptop, map of northern Norway on screen.

beats.vo: Instead there's a woman called Line, she's their head of brand, and she writes from a farm inside the Arctic circle.
beats.visual: She turns the laptop toward camera, scrolling the brand's own page.

beats.vo: Which matters less as a story and more as a reason the formulas are what they are — sea buckthorn, arnica, rosehip. Plants that have to survive up there.
beats.visual: Cut to the day balm jar on the desk beside the coffee, opened.

beats.vo: It's a balm, not a cream. Studies show 22% younger skin, and 95% reported youthful glow.
beats.visual: She takes a small amount, presses it into the back of her hand, shows the finish.

beats.vo: Thirty dollars. I went looking for a reason not to buy it and came back with the opposite.
beats.visual: Laptop closed, jar in frame, she shrugs at camera.

beats.vo: Anti-Age and Insane Glow Day Balm, from Frøya. Go and check them yourself.
beats.visual: Jar held to camera, brand name on screen.

cta: Anti-Age and Insane Glow Day Balm, from Frøya. Go and check them yourself.

avatar_brief: Woman 58-68, outdoors on a cold bright day, coat zipped, wind moving her hair. Handheld, slightly unsteady. Delivery is warm and unhurried with the cadence of someone used to being listened to.
hook: Cold does two things to skin and only one of them is bad.
first_frame: Outdoors, overcast bright light, her face fills the left of frame with bare landscape behind. Breath faintly visible.

beats.vo: Cold does two things to skin and only one of them is bad.
beats.visual: Outdoors, wind, handheld. She squints slightly against the light.

beats.vo: It strips you. But the plants that grow in it get dense — they concentrate, because they have to.
beats.visual: She gestures at the landscape behind her, camera follows loosely.

beats.vo: That's the whole idea behind this one. Arctic arnica, in a beeswax balm, made for the eye area.
beats.visual: Small jar produced from a coat pocket, held in a gloved hand.

beats.vo: Six of the ten top anti-age ingredients, and it looks less puffy in 4 to 9 days.
beats.visual: Ring finger tapping along the orbital bone, outdoors, no mirror.

beats.vo: Fifty-two dollars, and it's the one I take when I know I'll be out in weather.
beats.visual: She pockets the jar, pulls her collar up.

beats.vo: Magic Revive Eye Balm. Frøya. Made where the weather is worse than here.
beats.visual: Wide shot of her walking away, brand name on screen.

cta: Magic Revive Eye Balm. Frøya. Made where the weather is worse than here.

avatar_brief: Woman 30-40, bathroom, hair clipped up, mid-routine with a wet face. Fast, chatty delivery, slightly amused. She is the youngest avatar in this set on purpose — heritage as craft appeal rather than age appeal.
hook: Read the ingredients on your scrub. Mine used to be plastic and apricot dust.
first_frame: Close on her holding a generic scrub tube, squinting at the back-of-pack ingredients, face already wet.

beats.vo: Read the ingredients on your scrub. Mine used to be plastic and apricot dust.
beats.visual: She turns a generic tube to read the back, pulls a face.

beats.vo: This one is arctic rose petal. That's it, that's the abrasive. Rose petal.
beats.visual: Opens the Frøya scrub, tips some into her palm so the texture is visible.

beats.vo: It's rougher than you expect and gentler than it looks, which is a weird combination to describe and easy to feel.
beats.visual: Macro on the scrub between her fingertips.

beats.vo: Skin cells revive in 2 to 9 days. Instant deep and natural cleanse. That's their language, not mine.
beats.visual: She works it over her cheeks in small circles, water running.

beats.vo: Thirty-seven dollars, and I've stopped keeping the plastic one under the sink as a backup.
beats.visual: Rinsing, patting dry with a towel, no reveal shot.

beats.vo: Ultra Cleanse and Revive Face Scrub, from Frøya. Go and read your current one.
beats.visual: Jar on the edge of the sink, brand name on screen.

cta: Ultra Cleanse and Revive Face Scrub, from Frøya. Go and read your current one.
